title: ContentEnvelope
description: Transient opt-in content push (PRP-99): the prompt, response and tool text of one observed event, sent to the ingest edge only when a capture policy allows it. It is never stored, published, logged or returned; the edge redacts it (RedactedContent) and keeps only metadata on the event (payload_ref). The pair (source_id, event_id) joins it to its TelemetryEvent. Nothing but this schema and RedactedContent carries text; no other schema references it. Rule JSON Schema cannot express, enforced by the Python validator check_content_envelope_parts in tests/contracts/validators.py: at most one part per kind.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this document, major 1 with additive minor revisions.

cloud.description: Azure cloud boundary the content belongs to. Government data is never bridged to Commercial.

event_id.description: Source-assigned event identifier; with source_id it joins this envelope to its TelemetryEvent.

trace_id.description: W3C/OpenTelemetry trace ID, 32 lowercase hex characters.

span_id.description: Span ID, 16 lowercase hex characters. Null when not reported.

occurred_at.description: When the observed event happened at the source (RFC 3339 UTC).

parts.description: Content parts, one per kind, 1 to 5.

content_part.title: ContentPart
content_part.description: One part of the interaction content, exactly as the producer observed it (not yet redacted).

text.description: Part text, 1 to 32768 characters, no control characters except tab, CR and LF.

truncated.description: True when the producer cut the text before sending.
